description: Enumeration tables of the POSTFEKO Lua API, accessed as pf.Enums.<EnumName>.<Member>. They select result quantities on traces and 3D plots, data-set axis and quantity types, export and import file types, report and animation formats and graph formatting options. Member lists come from the auto-generated POSTFEKO API reference.

tools.name: pf.Enums.FarFieldQuantityTypeEnum
tools.description: Far-field quantity shown by a far-field trace or 3D plot (trace.Quantity.Type). It covers gain, directivity, realised gain, RCS, the E-field, axial ratio, handedness and total radiated power. Combine with pf.Enums.FarFieldQuantityComponentEnum to select the polarisation component.
tools.example:
local graph = app.CartesianGraphs:Add()
local tr = graph.Traces:Add(config.FarFields[1])
tr.Quantity.Type = pf.Enums.FarFieldQuantityTypeEnum.Gain
tr.Quantity.ValuesScaledToDB = true
tools.notes: Only Directivity was observed literally in the object examples; the other members come from the enumeration page.

tools.name: pf.Enums.FarFieldQuantityComponentEnum
tools.description: Polarisation component of a far-field quantity (trace.Quantity.Component): total, theta/phi, left/right-hand circular, Ludwig III co/cross, major/minor axis or the S and Z components.
tools.notes: Ludwig III components require the reference polarisation angle set on the quantity.

tools.name: pf.Enums.ImpedanceQuantityTypeEnum
tools.description: Quantity of an excitation (source) or load trace: impedance, admittance, voltage, current, reflection coefficient, VSWR, source power and mismatch loss. There is no SourceQuantityTypeEnum; excitation traces use this enumeration via trace.Quantity.Type.

parameters.name: ReflectionCoefficient
parameters.description: Reflection coefficient relative to the reference impedance.

tools.example:
local tr = graph.Traces:Add(config.Excitations[1])
tr.Quantity.Type = pf.Enums.ImpedanceQuantityTypeEnum.ReflectionCoefficient
tr.Quantity.ValuesScaledToDB = true
tools.notes: config.Excitations (not Sources) is the collection name, verified on 2026.1.

tools.name: pf.Enums.NetworkQuantityTypeEnum
tools.description: Quantity of a general network or transmission line trace: voltage, current, impedance, power or input power at a network port.
tools.notes: The collection name config.Networks follows the reference.

tools.name: pf.Enums.NetworkParameterTypeEnum
tools.description: Network parameter family (Scattering, Impedance or Admittance) used when exporting or displaying S-parameter data, together with pf.Enums.NetworkParameterFormatEnum (RI, MA, DB) for the Touchstone number format.
tools.notes: The six-argument Touchstone export signature (file, type, format, reference impedance, ?, samples) was taken from the reference and is not run-verified.

tools.name: pf.Enums.PowerQuantityTypeEnum
tools.description: Quantity of a power trace (config.Power): active (radiated/source) power, loss power or radiation efficiency.
tools.notes: config.Power is singular (config.Powers does not exist), verified on 2026.1.

tools.name: pf.Enums.SARQuantityTypeEnum
tools.description: Quantity of a SAR trace: the peak SAR, the average over the requested domain or the average over the total domain.
tools.notes: SAR requests are defined in CADFEKO with cfg.SAR:Add().

tools.name: pf.Enums.CharacteristicModeQuantityTypeEnum
tools.description: Quantity of a characteristic mode trace: eigenvalue, modal significance, characteristic angle, modal excitation coefficient or modal weighting coefficient, plotted against frequency or mode index.
tools.notes: SetFixedAxisValue("Mode index", 2, "") appears in the reference examples for CMA traces.

tools.name: pf.Enums.SurfaceCurrentsQuantityTypeEnum
tools.description: Quantity of a surface currents 3D plot or trace: electric currents, magnetic currents (on dielectric SEP surfaces) or charges. The wire counterpart is pf.Enums.WireCurrentsQuantityTypeEnum (Currents, Charges).
tools.notes: Currents requests appear as config.SurfaceCurrents and config.WireCurrents (there is no config.Currents).

tools.name: pf.Enums.WireCurrentsQuantityTypeEnum
tools.description: Quantity of a wire currents plot: segment currents or line charges along the wires of the model.
tools.notes: Use a Cartesian graph trace on the same data to plot current versus segment index.

tools.name: pf.Enums.ReceivingAntennaQuantityTypeEnum
tools.description: Quantity of an ideal receiving antenna trace: received (active) power, loss power, efficiency or relative signal phase.
tools.notes: Collection name config.ReceivingAntennas follows the reference.

tools.name: pf.Enums.TRCoefficientQuantityTypeEnum
tools.description: Quantity of a transmission/reflection coefficient trace for periodic structures and planar substrates: Transmission or Reflection.
tools.notes: Collection name config.TRCoefficients follows the reference.

tools.name: pf.Enums.ErrorEstimateQuantityTypeEnum
tools.description: Element class of an error-estimate plot: all elements, triangles, segments or tetrahedra.
tools.notes: Error estimates are requested in CADFEKO with cfg.ErrorEstimations:Add() (EE card).

tools.name: pf.Enums.NearFieldQuantityTypeEnum
tools.description: Quantity of a near-field plot or trace: E- and H-fields, electric/magnetic flux density, the Poynting vector, SAR on near-field points, and the scalar/vector potentials with their gradients.

parameters.name: ScalarEPotentialGradient
parameters.description: Gradient of the electric scalar potential.

parameters.name: ScalarHPotentialGradient
parameters.description: Gradient of the magnetic scalar potential.

tools.example:
local plot = view.Plots:Add(config.NearFields[1])
plot.Quantity.Type = pf.Enums.NearFieldQuantityTypeEnum.EField
plot.Quantity.ComplexComponent = pf.Enums.ComplexComponentEnum.Magnitude
tools.notes: Potentials are only available when the near-field request was configured for potentials (NearFieldCalculationTypeEnum.Potentials).

tools.name: pf.Enums.ComplexComponentEnum
tools.description: Complex component displayed for a complex quantity (quantity.ComplexComponent): magnitude, phase, real part, imaginary part or the instantaneous value at the current phase/time.
tools.notes: Enumeration exists in the POSTFEKO reference (member list from the enumeration page).

tools.name: pf.Enums.PolarisationTypeEnum
tools.description: Polarisation selection for far-field quantities that support co/cross-polar decomposition (quantity.Polarisation): total, co-polarisation or cross-polarisation.
tools.notes: Property name Polarisation follows the FarFieldQuantity reference.

tools.name: pf.Enums.DataSetAxisEnum
tools.description: Predefined axis types for pf.DataSet axes (dataSet.Axes:Add(axisEnum, unit, start, end, count)). Frequency, Theta, Phi, X/Y/Z, R/Rho, Time, Mode, Solution and the incident-angle axes match the axes of built-in result data sets so that custom data can be plotted like native results.

parameters.name: IncidentTheta
parameters.description: Incident theta of a plane wave.

parameters.name: IncidentPhi
parameters.description: Incident phi of a plane wave.

tools.notes: Axes can also be added by name string; the enumeration guarantees compatibility with StoreData types.

tools.name: pf.Enums.DataSetQuantityTypeEnum
tools.description: Value type of a pf.DataSet quantity (dataSet.Quantities:Add(name, type, unit)): scalar, complex, boolean, string or enumeration.
tools.notes: Native data sets expose the same types (for example Impedance is Complex, Power is Scalar, SourceType is Enum).

tools.name: pf.Enums.StoredDataTypeEnum
tools.description: Result type under which a data set is stored with dataSet:StoreData(type). Storing a custom data set as FarField, NearField, Source, SParameter and so on makes it available in the corresponding result category so that it can be plotted with the native quantity options.
tools.notes: The axes and quantity names must match the target type (for example Frequency/Theta/Phi and Gain-like quantities for FarField).

tools.name: pf.Enums.MathScriptTypeEnum
tools.description: Result type produced by a math script (app.MathScripts:Add(type)). The member list mirrors StoredDataTypeEnum so that a script can emit far-field, near-field, source, network or custom data sets.
tools.example:
local ms = app.MathScripts:Add(pf.Enums.MathScriptTypeEnum.FarField)
ms.Script = [[ local ff = pf.FarField.GetDataSet("model.StandardConfiguration1.FarField1") return ff ]]
ms:Run()
tools.notes: Script and Run property/method names follow the MathScript reference.

tools.name: pf.Enums.ReportDocumentTypeEnum
tools.description: Output document type of quick reports and report templates (app:CreateQuickReport(filename, type) and app.Reports:Add(template, type)): PDF, Microsoft Word or PowerPoint. The related pf.Enums.ReportImageSizeEnum controls the image size used in generated reports.
tools.example:
local report = app:CreateQuickReport("summary", pf.Enums.ReportDocumentTypeEnum.MSWord)
report:SetPageIncluded("Cartesian graph1", false)
report:Generate()
tools.notes: CreateQuickReport(filename, type) signature confirmed from the reference.

tools.name: pf.Enums.AnimationTypeEnum
tools.description: Animation mode of a 3D view (view.Animation.Type): sweep the phase, the frequency, the time step, or rotate the view about theta and/or phi.

parameters.name: Phase
parameters.description: Animate the phase of complex quantities.

tools.notes: Property path view.Animation.Type follows the View reference.

tools.name: pf.Enums.AnimationFormatEnum
tools.description: Video format for view:ExportAnimation(filename, format, quality, width, height, framerate); AVI is the format used in the reference examples. The companion pf.Enums.AnimationQualityEnum (for example Normal) sets the encoding quality.
tools.usage: view:ExportAnimation(file, pf.Enums.AnimationFormatEnum.<Member>, pf.Enums.AnimationQualityEnum.Normal, w, h, fps)
tools.notes: Only AVI (format) and Normal (quality) were observed in the reference examples; other members may exist.

tools.name: pf.Enums.FarFieldsExportTypeEnum
tools.description: Quantity written to a .ffe file by farField:ExportData(filename, type, samples) or config:ExportFarFields(filename, type, samples): gain, directivity, realised gain or RCS. Passing only a filename is rejected ("Invalid parameters (FarFieldData, string)").
tools.notes: The samples argument is the number of frequency samples for continuous results (1 for discrete).

tools.name: pf.Enums.NearFieldsExportTypeEnum
tools.description: Field type written by a near-field export (nearField:ExportData or config:ExportNearFields): electric (.efe), magnetic (.hfe) or both.
tools.notes: Argument pattern mirrors the far-field export; not run-verified.

tools.name: pf.Enums.CurrentsExportTypeEnum
tools.description: Data written by a currents export (.os/.ol files): currents, charges or both.
tools.notes: Argument pattern mirrors the far-field export; not run-verified.

tools.name: pf.Enums.ImportFileTypeEnum
tools.description: File type for app:ImportResults(filename, type) (or a list of filenames): Feko far-field (.ffe), electric/magnetic/combined near-field (.efe/.hfe) or Touchstone files, for example measured data to compare against simulations.
tools.example:
local imported = app:ImportResults("measured.s2p", pf.Enums.ImportFileTypeEnum.Touchstone)
local tr = graph.Traces:Add(app.ImportedDataSets[1].ImportedData[1])
tools.notes: Imported sets are listed in app.ImportedDataSets (ImportSet objects with ImportedData collections).

tools.name: pf.Enums.GraphLegendPositionEnum
tools.description: Legend placement on a 2D graph (graph.Legend.Position): outside on one of the four sides, overlaid in a corner, at a custom position or hidden. The 3D view counterpart is pf.Enums.ViewLegendPositionEnum.
tools.notes: Property path graph.Legend.Position follows the reference.

tools.name: pf.Enums.SamplingMethodEnum
tools.description: Sampling of continuous (adaptive frequency) results on a trace (trace.Sampling.Method): automatic, the discrete solver samples, or a specified number of samples.
tools.notes: Property names follow the reference (NumberOfSamples not run-verified).

tools.name: pf.Enums.NormalisationMethodEnum
tools.description: Normalisation of graph traces (graph.Normalisation): normalise each trace individually or all traces to the common maximum.

parameters.name: IndividualTraces
parameters.description: Each trace to its own maximum.

parameters.name: AllTraces
parameters.description: All traces to the global maximum.

tools.notes: Alternatively set trace.Quantity.ValuesNormalised on a single trace.

tools.name: pf.Enums.FrequencyUnitEnum
tools.description: Frequency unit for graph axes and exports: Hz, kHz, MHz or GHz.
tools.notes: Exact axis property path may differ per graph type; the enumeration members are confirmed.

tools.name: pf.Enums.AxesScaleEnum
tools.description: Scaling of the coordinate axes drawn in a 3D view (view.Axes.Scale): scale with the model, scale with the window or use a specified length.

parameters.name: ScaleWithModel
parameters.description: Axis length relative to model size.

tools.notes: Property names follow the View reference.

tools.name: pf.Enums.AnnotationBeamwidthTypeEnum
tools.description: Beamwidth type for graph annotations added with graph.Annotations:AddBeamwidthAnnotation(trace, beamwidthType, relativeType); HalfPowerBeamwidth marks the 3 dB beamwidth. The companion pf.Enums.AnnotationRelativeTypeEnum (for example RelativeToGlobalMax) defines the reference level.
tools.notes: Only HalfPowerBeamwidth and RelativeToGlobalMax were observed in the reference examples.

tools.name: pf.Enums catalogue overview (colour, marker, legend and scale enumerations)
tools.description: Summary of the remaining POSTFEKO enumerations that control formatting rather than data: ColourEnum (named trace/plot colours), MarkerSymbolEnum (trace markers), LinearScaleRangeTypeEnum (3D legend range), LoadingTypeEnum, ViewLegendPositionEnum, ReportImageSizeEnum, AnimationQualityEnum and AnnotationRelativeTypeEnum. All are accessed as pf.Enums.<Name>.<Member> and can be listed at run time with printlist(pf.Enums).
tools.usage: printlist(pf.Enums)  -- list every enumeration; printlist(pf.Enums.ColourEnum) lists members
tools.example:
-- in a POSTFEKO script
printlist(pf.Enums.MarkerSymbolEnum)
tr.Line.Colour = pf.Enums.ColourEnum.Red
tr.Markers.Symbol = pf.Enums.MarkerSymbolEnum.Circle
tools.notes: Member names Red/Circle are illustrative; use printlist to see the exact members of your version. The full catalogue in the 2026 reference contains about 79 enumerations.
